topic: Tortillas instead of bread on the ISS
hook: Your sandwich in space would be a tortilla.
title: Astronauts Can't Eat Bread in Space
description:
Bread makes crumbs, and crumbs float in space. They can drift into equipment and even into eyes. That is why ISS crews eat tortillas instead.

#Shorts #Space #ISS
